instruction: Bedroom Split IFC CSV Space Schedule Start from the provided IFC model at init.ifc and reference image at init_plan.png. Modify the single-floor apartment so the former bedroom is split into two bedrooms, save the completed model as result.ifc, and use Bonsai/IfcCSV-style IFC data export to save the space schedule as result.csv. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.csv with those exact relative paths. 2. Result.ifc is an IFC4 file with exactly one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, and one IfcBuildingStorey. 3. Result.ifc contains exactly five IfcSpace objects, with one space named Living, one named Kitchen, one named Bed 1, one named Bed 2, and one named Bath after case-insensitive normalization of spaces, hyphens, and underscores. 4. Result.ifc contains at least eight IfcWall objects, no IfcBuildingElementProxy objects, no IfcFurniture objects, at least one IfcDoor, at least one IfcRelVoidsElement, and at least one IfcRelFillsElement. 5. Result.csv contains headers SpaceName, Level, and NetFloorArea, matched case-insensitively while ignoring spaces, hyphens, and underscores. 6. Result.csv contains exactly one row for each required space name Living, Kitchen, Bed 1, Bed 2, and Bath; each of those rows has Level equal to Ground Floor after normalization and a positive numeric NetFloorArea. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
